title: Circular Tour
problemStatement: There are n petrol pumps arranged in a circle. Each petrol pump provides a certain amount of petrol and requires a certain amount of petrol to travel to the next pump. Determine the first petrol pump from which a truck can complete the entire circular tour. If no such starting point exists, return -1.
input: Integer n Array petrol Array distance
output: The starting pump index, or -1 if impossible.
